text.title: User Story Mapping Worked Example
text.summary: End-to-end worked example showing inputs → procedure → output for a typical instance of User Story Mapping.

example.scenario: Project-management tool. Backbone reads "Sign up → Create Project → Invite Teammate → Track Task → Close Project" — five verb phrases, read aloud as one narrative. Each activity carries 3-5 tasks including an error path (failed invite, empty project, task with no assignee). Walking skeleton = magic-link signup, blank project, email invite, plain task list, one-click close: exactly one task per activity, end-to-end completeable. Release 1 spans the same five activities and adds OAuth, project templates, Slack invite, due dates and a retro step.
example.trace: r1-backbone-first (verb phrases, read aloud) → r6-error-path-included → r3-vertical-alternatives (ranked, capped) → r2-walking-skeleton (one task per activity) → r7-full-backbone-slices → validated artefact

example.scenario: Solo PM maps onboarding (3 activities × 8 tasks × 22 stories); walking-skeleton slice covers 8 stories; Release 1 adds 6 more; Later horizon carries the rest.
